mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 3.5% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signals a balanced economy, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2%), rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105) amplifies economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS <2% and INDPRO >105.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in manufacturing demand (HOUST < 1200) signals weakening industrial activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite HOUST dropping below.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) combined with robust demand (RSAFS) creates a virtuous cycle of consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0%) indicate tightening monetary policy, which dampens growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS >2.5% and UNRATE <3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market strength, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite UNRATE falling below 3.5%.
